title: AuthorAddNameParams
description:
`author.add_name` params: a composed name, optionally bound to its bearer.

The AST's [`NameItem`](dli_ast::language::NameItem) has four variants; two
are load-bearing here. `Composition` and `Bearer` are [`Self::composition`]
and [`Self::bearer`]. `Provenance` is not exposed — it would be a second,
competing spelling of [`Self::provenance`], and the header-first precedence
rule would silently pick one. `Other` is by definition a clause the name
grammar does not recognize, which a typed constructor cannot produce.

bearer.description: The entity that bears the name, if the name is bound to one.

composition.description: The composition steps: each a slot role filled by a named morpheme.

label.description: The rendered label (data, never an instruction).

CompositionStep.description: One composition step: a slot role filled by a named morpheme.

Provenance.description:
Provenance supplied when adding authored material. Internally tagged on
`kind`; origin tracking is load-bearing for the authoring seam (nothing an agent supplies
mints authority).

oneOf.description: Cited to one or more decisions: `{"kind":"cited","decisions":["D-0104"]}`.

decisions.description: The cited decision identifiers in the consuming repo's ledger.

state.description: The requested standing on contract 1.5 and above.

origin.description: The origin token of the proposal (e.g. an agent session id).

hyp.description: The hypothesis the material is conditioned on.

ProvenanceState.description:
The stored standing requested for a cited authoring operation.

The field is optional here so pre-1.5 wire frames remain decodable. The
1.5 request boundary requires it for `kind: cited`.
